vb_textbox.text: Gnomes come in 4 colours, brown, red, purple and green. They also have different hats shapes in case you are colorblind.The best gnomes seem to go in waves, for a while there will be a better result for (example) the purple and red gnomes, then the reward for these gnomes will gradually go down and switch to the brown/green gnomes. I would norally switched pair when i got as low as +3 reward.The test is a bit long, so make sure you use the toilet and hydrate before starting!Oh, and don't forget to press space to collect your reward from the gnomes!
